title: Torque ripple attenuation of PMSM using improved robust two-degree-of-freedom controller via extended sliding mode parameter observer
author: Mingfei Huang; Yongting Deng; Hongwen Li; Jianli Wang
version: Volume 129, Part B, October 2022, pages 558–571; Epub 2022-02-07
locator: Robust two-degree-of-freedom control, iterative learning, extended sliding-mode parameter observer and disturbance feedforward
notes: Research combines a robust two-degree-of-freedom controller, iterative learning and a parameter observer for PMSM torque-ripple attenuation. The abstract reports simulation/experimental results in its studied setup. Its architecture is a research option, not a drop-in CNC controller function or verified result for other machines.
